The fortifications and ordnance are omitted in all the years before the war, as well as in the estimate for 1820; and as there was no ordnance corps before the war,
the expense of that corps should also be deducted from the current expenditures of the army, for this year, amounting to $ 101,496 60. If to this, are added, the Auditor’s
